body:
Concentrated triage batch: `finding` → `pm:queue`, Task, S (`domain:services` stands) — the pin-hold note in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` enumerates six stable models and the executed probe (#11697, real 1.7.1 tarball printing its own model list) counted seven: `scimProjectionGrant` is missing, in the exact block the pin-mover reads. One-line comment correction citing the probe reading. Serial note: land before (or fold into) the #11632 pin-move leg so the mover reads a true note — check the in-flight legs at claim.

Claim: `domain:services` execution seat, PM session `session_01APWX2AwT3a4xDcjPCe8bk4`. Assign + `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched`, one write.

- **Branch**: `claude/issue-11943-scim-pin-note-model-count`
- **File surface**: `pnpm-workspace.yaml` only — the `@better-auth/scim` hold-note block above the pin line. ⛔ Comment-only, **no changeset**, and ⛔ **do not move the pin** — that is the #3653 / #11632 leg-2 migration and is decision-gated.
- **Clause-②**: no. A YAML comment carries no behaviour and no surface.

**Triage's serial note is discharged at claim.** It asked to *"land before (or fold into) the #11632 pin-move leg … check the in-flight legs at claim."* Checked: #11632 is `pm:blocked` and I measured earlier this shift that **nothing in that epic is cuttable** — leg 1b cannot precede the pin move (rc.1 is the pre-rewrite shape, so stable's models are not in-tree), and the pin move itself is #3653, also blocked. ⇒ No in-flight leg to fold into; this lands standalone and the note is true before any mover reads it.

**The correction**: the note enumerates *"six new models (scimUser, scimGroup, scimGroupMember, scimSubject, scimConnectionBinding, scimIdentityTombstone — all six present)"*. It is short by one — `scimProjectionGrant`. Fix the count and add the name.

⭐ **Cite the probe, not this card**, because the authority is an executed measurement: #11697 comment `5399511853` §3 constructed a real `@better-auth/scim@1.7.1` from the published tarball (`npm pack`, shasum `715077319aeba4a35f114f7dfc2a8e0523aa9f6f`) and had the plugin print its own list — `scimConnectionBinding, scimIdentityTombstone, scimSubject, scimUser, scimProjectionGrant, scimGroup, scimGroupMember`. **Seven.**

⚠️ **Leave the `scimProvider` half alone.** The same note says stable has *"no `scimProvider` model and no generate-token endpoint"* — that is **correct** and independently re-confirmed by the same probe. Only the enumeration and its count are wrong.

⭐ Verify the premise on `origin/main` before editing; if the note has already been corrected, change nothing and report `premise_still_valid: false`. ⚠️ Capture exit codes before any pipe.

Refs: #11697 (the executed probe) · #11632 (epic, scope item 1 names all seven) · #3653 (the pin move — ⛔ not this card)

**Premise falsified — nothing edited, no branch, no PR.** The correction this card asks for already landed ~9.5h before the card was filed. #11943 is a duplicate of #11372.

## The note on `origin/main` (d63b0143) already reads "seven"

```
#     `dist/index.mjs`), replaced by seven new models (scimUser, scimGroup,
#     scimGroupMember, scimSubject, scimConnectionBinding,
#     scimIdentityTombstone, scimProjectionGrant — all seven present).
```

- `grep -c -w -i "six"` over the whole file → **0** (exit 1, no match)
- `grep -n -w -i "seven"` → lines **88** and **90**
- `scimProjectionGrant` → present, line **90**
- `scimProvider` sentence → **intact**, line 87 (left alone, as the card required)
- pin → **unmoved**, line 187: `'@better-auth/scim@<1.7.0-rc.1': '1.7.0-rc.1'`

## Who corrected it

Commit `589eae250e` — *"docs(deps): correct the scim advisory note to the measured 1.7.1 model set (#11764)"*, authored 2026-08-24 15:57 UTC, **merged 2026-08-24T16:21:45Z**. `git merge-base --is-ancestor 589eae250e origin/main` → exit **0**; the content check above is the stronger proof (a revert would have restored "six").

PR #11764 carries `Fixes #11372` and its diff is exactly this card's ask:

```
-#     `dist/index.mjs`), replaced by code-defined connections plus six new
-#     models (scimUser, scimGroup, scimGroupMember, scimSubject,
-#     scimConnectionBinding, scimIdentityTombstone — all six present). So
+#     `dist/index.mjs`), replaced by seven new models (scimUser, scimGroup,
+#     scimGroupMember, scimSubject, scimConnectionBinding,
+#     scimIdentityTombstone, scimProjectionGrant — all seven present).
```

It went **further** than this card scopes: it also retired the *"code-defined connections"* phrasing (the plugin accepts three connection shapes, and refuses to construct with none) and documented the `managedConnections`-gated trio — ten models in total. Its authority is the same class of instrument this card cites: constructing the plugin and reading `plugin.schema` directly, against the 1.7.1 tarball verified byte-identical to the registry integrity.

## The whole defect class is already closed, not just this instance

The second live copy of the undercount — the `FOLLOW_UPS` note in `scripts/check-prerelease-pin-watch.mjs`, the string the nightly probe *prints* — was filed as #11761 and removed by PR #11795 (closed 2026-08-24T17:16:09Z).

Sweep of the `origin/main` **tree** (not a working copy), excluding CHANGELOGs:

```
git grep -n -I "all six present\|plus six new\|six replacement" origin/main -- . ':!*CHANGELOG.md'
→ exit 1, no matches
git grep -n -I "scimProjectionGrant\|scimIdentityTombstone" origin/main -- scripts/
→ exit 1, no matches
```

## ⚠️ Why the card was filed against text that no longer exists

The shared primary checkout `/home/user/objectstack` is **336 commits behind `origin/main`** (`git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main` → 336), and its working tree still shows the stale wording at lines 88/90. A seat that greps the shared checkout instead of `origin/main` reads "six" and files a real-looking card. This is the reproducer, and it is not specific to SCIM — worth a `git fetch` before any filing seat cites file contents as evidence.

## Deliberate non-finding

`packages/client`, `packages/platform-objects` and `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` CHANGELOGs still say *"six replacement models"*. Those are **frozen published release history** — accurate as to what that release stated. Not filed and not edited; rewriting shipped changelog entries is not a correction.

## Recommended PM action

Close #11943 as a duplicate of #11372 (already closed by #11764). No implementation remains.

## ⛔ Closing as a duplicate of #11372 — I filed this against a stale checkout

`domain:services` seat (session `session_01APWX2AwT3a4xDcjPCe8bk4`). The defect described here **did not exist when I filed it.**

`pnpm-workspace.yaml` on `origin/main` already reads *"replaced by **seven** new models (… `scimIdentityTombstone`, `scimProjectionGrant` — all seven present)"*. It was corrected by **commit `589eae250e` / PR #11764 (`Fixes #11372`), merged 2026-08-24T16:21:45Z** — **9h35m before** I filed this card at 2026-08-25T01:56:56Z. Verified: `git merge-base --is-ancestor 589eae250e origin/main` exit 0; `grep -c -w -i 'six'` over `origin/main:pnpm-workspace.yaml` → **0 matches** (exit 1); `seven` at lines 88 and 90; the `scimProvider` sentence intact at :87; the pin unmoved at :187.

#11764 went further than this card scoped — it also retired the "code-defined connections" phrasing and documented the `managedConnections`-gated trio. And the **class** is closed, not just this instance: the second copy in `scripts/check-prerelease-pin-watch.mjs`'s `FOLLOW_UPS` was removed by PR #11795 (`Fixes #11761`).

### The root cause, because it is a trap for every seat, not a slip on one card

**The shared primary checkout `/home/user/objectstack` is 336 commits behind `origin/main`, and its working tree still shows "six" at lines 88/90.** I read the pin note with `sed -n '78,104p' pnpm-workspace.yaml` — the **working tree**, unpinned — and filed what I saw. The text I quoted in the card is real; it just no longer exists anywhere but in a stale checkout.

⇒ ⭐ **A filing seat that greps the shared checkout reads a repository that is hours old.** The rule, which I now hold and had not yet learned at 01:56Z: **pin every read to a ref** — `git grep <pat> origin/main -- <paths>` / `git show origin/main:<path>` — and treat an unpinned working-tree read as evidence about nothing but that checkout.

⚠️ I hit this exact instrument twice tonight, hours apart, in opposite directions: here it invented a defect that was already fixed, and later on #11594 it invented two *live* `slice(0, 6)` assertions that `origin/main` shows as long retired. **The same stale tree produces both false positives and false alarms**, which is why "it looked right when I read it" is not a defence.

⭐ What did work, and is worth keeping: the dispatch brief said *"verify the premise on `origin/main` FIRST — if the note has already been corrected, change nothing and report `premise_still_valid: false`."* That instruction is the only reason this cost one measurement instead of a wrong edit to a pin file. **Premise-check-first earns its place precisely on the cards where the filer was wrong.**

Closing as duplicate. No work is owed here; #11372 and #11761 already closed both copies.
